entry.author: KiwiRail
entry.summary:
To prepare for the more frequent passenger services that the City Rail Link will bring once open, KiwiRail and City Rail Link Limited have added new Traction Section Cabins (TSCs) to Auckland’s rail network for increased reliability. 

To improve the appearance of these large buildings and enhance the surrounding environment for passengers and local communities, artists Ross Liew and Margarita Vovna recently painted stunning murals on the Quay Park and Mount Eden TSCs.

Watch this video to learn how TSCs work and hear about the inspiration behind the murals at both sites.
